t: Who he called a slave, and to what
a: تَعِسَ عَبْدُ الدِّينَارِ وَالدِّرْهَمِ وَالْقَطِيفَةِ وَالْخَمِيصَةِ، إِنْ أُعْطِيَ رَضِيَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطَ لَمْ يَرْضَ
p: Taʿisa ʿabdu-d-dīnāri wa-d-dirhami wa-l-qaṭīfati wa-l-khamīṣah. In uʿṭiya raḍiya, wa in lam yuʿṭa lam yarḍa
m: Wretched is the slave of the dinar and the dirham and the fine cloth and the patterned cloak. If he is given he is pleased, and if he is not given he is not pleased.
